description: 12-message session for the HW6 Part 2 demo (>= 10 messages so the short-term window, a session summary at messages 5 and 10, the lifetime summary, and episodic retrieval are all visible). The persona is fictional test data.
messages: Hi, my name is Sam and I'm looking for an apartment in Santa Clara.
My budget is at most $2,300 a month.
I have a cat named Pixel, so I need a pet-friendly place.
I'd like to move in on March 1, 2027.
I commute to SJSU by light rail, so being near a station matters.
What areas of Santa Clara are close to a light rail station?
Do pet-friendly buildings usually charge pet rent for cats?
I also need one covered parking spot.
What security deposit should I expect for a one-bedroom?
Which of my requirements is hardest to meet on my budget?
Can you remind me what my cat is called and my move-in date?
Summarize everything you know about my apartment search.
